chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ash'ari, from his father, who said:
I asked Abā al-Hasan عليه السلام about a man who recites in Salat al-Jumu'ah something other than al-Jumu'ah intentionally. He said: There is no problem.

key_terms.بِغَيْرِ الْجُمُعَةِ: with something other than Sūrat al-Jumu'ah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite other than Sūrat al-Jumu'ah in Friday prayer intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on reciting a surah other than Sūrat al-Jumu'ah in Salat al-Jumu'ah deliberately. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem in doing so, indicating permissibility in this matter.
